name: @numinia/till
description: The till — Numinia's pay-per-use ledger: each account's balance in euro cents as lines only ever added, and the nightly close of each UTC day (ADR-070, MIS-177, MIS-178). A Worker of its own with its own D1 database.

scripts.deploy: npm run build --prefix ../../packages/domain && wrangler d1 migrations apply TILL_DB --remote && wrangler deploy
